chunks: They will offer submission to God that Day, and the lies they fabricated will not be of the least avail.
ai.seo_question: What happens to the false gods and fabricated lies of disbelievers on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the futility of fabricated ideologies and false deities when confronted with divine reality, marking the transition from self-deception to absolute submission. The phrase 'al-salam' (submission) signifies not just passive surrender but the acknowledgment of God's sole authority, while the departure of their 'fabrications' illustrates the collapse of worldly constructs that lacked spiritual substance. This moment serves as a profound lesson for believers to anchor their faith in truth rather than transient, man-made narratives.
